title: Benchmark Ear Impression Techniques
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the scan quality of the direct ear scanner concerning consistency, accuracy and reliability and to compare the data to common silicone ear impressions by benchmarking the outcome of each impression technique on custom product dummies on participants.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Only adult participants ≥ 18 years
* Informed consent form as documented by signature
* Ability to fill in a questionnaire conscientious
* Healthy outer ear (Pinna and ear canal, w/o previous surgical procedures)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contraindications to the MD in this study, e.g. known hypersensitivity or allergy to the investigational product
* Inability to follow the procedures of the study, e.g. due to language problems, psychological disorders, dementia, etc. of the participant
